NAME: GARUDA SoC verification plan
details: Top-level plan for garuda_chip_top, Rev 4.0 specification set. Flow: vPlan, static, block and IP, CPU core, integration, SoC top. Each block has its own plan, taken from its specification (sections 2, 10, 11); this plan holds the stages and points at them. Results quoted are from the 2026-10-04 run (Xcelium make regress_all at 08:27, vManager session 119 of 119).

NAME: Stage 2 - Static
details: Lint, clock-domain checks and formal, before any simulation result is trusted.

NAME: HAL lint on garuda_chip_top
details: No HAL error left without a fix or a written reason.
implementation_note: irun -hal with flow/2_static/hal.f. First run 696 errors; 5 remain, all dispositioned in flow/2_static/hal_waivers.txt (4 in vendored IP, 1 required by CORE N-7.33). Two RTL fixes came from lint: I2C-5, PWM-1.

NAME: Clock-domain crossings
details: tck to hclk in dmi_cdc is the only asynchronous boundary; every crossing synchronised or justified.
implementation_note: HAL CLOCKDOMAIN on debug_top: synchronisers found on the request and acknowledge toggles; 5 qualified-data crossings waived on the handshake argument (BUGS.md CDC-1).

NAME: Formal on pipe_ctrl
details: CORE N-11.3 properties proved, hold-versus-flush cells shown reachable or unreachable.
implementation_note: NOT RUN: no Incisive_Formal_Verifier licence on the server (BUGS.md FV-1). Set up in flow/2_static/fv_pipe_ctrl. The cells were closed in simulation instead (AUD-8).

NAME: Stage 4 - CPU core
details: The RV32IM core and the DSU, alone, against Spike and the DSU model.

NAME: Core plan
details: Block plan: tb/core/GARUDA_CORE_vplan.csv (from GARUDA-CORE-SPEC-001). The 2026-07-20 workbook tb/core/GARUDA_Core_Verification_Plan.xlsx holds the unit-level rows.
implementation_note: 20 unit and element benches pass with 0 assertion failures.

NAME: DSU plan
details: Block plan: tb/dsu/GARUDA_DSU_vplan.csv (from GARUDA-DSU-SPEC-001). The 2026-07-20 workbook tb/dsu/GARUDA_DSU_Verification_Plan.xlsx holds the test-level rows.
implementation_note: tb_dsu_top against the model: 445 compared, 0 mismatches.

NAME: ISA tests with Spike lockstep
details: rv32ui, rv32um, rv32mi: each test checks itself; 57 of the 63 are also compared with Spike instruction for instruction; p-div, p-divu, p-rem, p-remu, p-sbreak and p-mcsr are judged by their own pass/fail only, because GARUDA and Spike differ there by design (software divide, CLIC mtvec, mimpid).
implementation_note: 63 of 63; and under random bus waits (make regress_rand) 63 of 63 in the last run.

NAME: Directed core programs
details: Interrupts, WFI and clock gate, bus error, DSU, CLIC sweep, timer wake, hold-versus-flush matrix, DSU back to back.

NAME: Hold versus flush matrix
details: CORE N-11.2: every hold cause against every flush cause, 19 cells, checked on architectural state.
implementation_note: sw/tests/t_hold_flush_matrix.S passes under the interrupt-period and wait-state sweep (+IRQ_EVERY, +DWAIT, +DRAND) that found T-11 and P-8; found T-9, T-11, P-4 to P-8, C-15, DSU-13.

details: Block plan: tb/ahb/GARUDA_AHB_vplan.csv (from GARUDA-AHB-SPEC-001).

NAME: Interrupt lines and DMA request lines and bus faults
details: Every DMA and peripheral interrupt reaches its CLIC ID; every DMA request reaches its own channel and no other; an unmapped offset in every window, an absent window and a sub-word access each give one precise bus fault.
implementation_note: sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c on tb_chip, pass. Found T-9, T-10, INT-2, INT-3.

NAME: Map generated from the system description
details: garuda_map.vh and garuda_map.h match Design_Docs/garuda_system.yaml.
implementation_note: python3 tools/garuda_gen.py --check passes. INT-1 added the SPI slave window and DMA channel.

NAME: Whole-chip elaboration
details: garuda_chip_top elaborates with nothing unresolved.
implementation_note: make elab_chip; Genus check_design of 2026-09-26: 0 unresolved, undriven or multi-driven.

NAME: t_chip_basic
details: boot path, ILOCK, precise bus faults, DMA

NAME: t_chip_irq
details: DMA completion through the CLIC, machine timer, watchdog warning, WFI and clock gate

NAME: t_chip_wdt
details: a real watchdog reset, RSTREASON, DSRAM survives

NAME: t_chip_flash
details: boot from SPI flash: image read, CRC-32, ILOCK, jump

NAME: t_chip_uart
details: three UARTs through the pins

NAME: t_chip_periph
details: SPI master, I2C, GPIO, PWM, SPI slave through the pins

NAME: t_chip_integ
details: the stage 5 integration program

NAME: t_chip_jtag
details: halt, load ISRAM over SBA, mailbox, resume, run

NAME: X-propagation
details: No X reaches the bus or a pin after reset.
implementation_note: xrun -xprop F on t_chip_basic and t_chip_integ: pass. Other chip tests not run with X-propagation.
